transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I just haven’t been feeling like myself. Things I used to like—dance class, hiking, cooking, game night—they all feel like chores now, so I keep putting them off.
Do you still enjoy things when you finally get around to doing them?
Not really. Even if I make myself go, it doesn’t feel like it used to. Dance, hiking, cooking… game night. It all kind of feels like something I’m supposed to do, not something I actually want.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
Most days, yeah… not exactly sad, maybe more like this low fear and guilt sitting there under everything. Even when nothing’s really happening.
Do you still find pleasure in things that you used to enjoy, or has that changed?
It’s changed. I don’t really get much pleasure from those things anymore… dance class, hiking, cooking, even game night. They mostly just feel like chores I keep putting off.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?

Yeah… I guess so. Mostly in places like parking lots, or when I’m picking someone up. I keep checking who’s around me, where my car is, how quickly I could leave. Other people seem fine, but I don’t really relax.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how quickly you move compared to before you started feeling this way?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed moving slower or anything like that… maybe I’m tired sometimes, but I haven’t paid close attention.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?
Not really… I haven’t noticed anything major with my weight.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
No… not really. I mean, I don’t think about hurting myself.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things like that.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower.
Do you often feel worthless or that you're not a good person?
I don’t know if I’d say worthless exactly… but most days I feel this kind of fear and guilt sitting there, even when nothing’s really happening. It just… makes me feel bad about myself, I guess.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Not that I’ve noticed… my clothes feel about the same, I think.
Have you had thoughts about death or dying?
I… no, not really. I don’t think about dying like that.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
Um… I’m not sure. I don’t think I’m especially fidgety. Maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it.
Have you lost a lot of weight unintentionally since you started feeling this way?
I don’t think so… not a lot. I haven’t really been keeping track, but my clothes still fit about the same.
Do you often feel like you're moving around more than you need to?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think I move around more than I need to. I haven’t noticed that.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or have a lot of restless energy?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower or having a lot of extra energy. Maybe a little tense sometimes, but not like that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since… the robbery at that festival job. So, I guess about two years and three months now.
Would you say your low mood and lack of interest in activities are present most of the day or nearly every day?
Yeah… I think so. Most days I just don’t really care about the things I used to like—dance class, hiking, cooking, game night. They all feel like… chores now, I guess.
How many months have you been feeling this low mood and lack of interest in activities?
About… 27 months, I guess. Since the robbery at that festival job.
